Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the actor who played Batman in the "new Justice League" as Ben Affleck. While Ben Affleck played Batman in *Justice League* (2017) and *Zack Snyder's Justice League* (2021), the actor who played Batman in the *original* 1989/1992 films (often referred to as the "new" Batman in the context of the 1993 film *Dazed and Confused*, which was released during that era) was Michael Keaton. Ben Affleck did not appear in *Dazed and Confused* (1993). The error stems from a misinterpretation of the term "new Justice League" and a failure to correctly link the actor to the 1993 film, leading to a hallucinated character name ("Shannon Hamilton") for Ben Affleck in that movie.
